"dB-Hz over the last 2 minutes: a sudden, general drop gives a jammer away"
"Jamming: a transmitter drowns the satellites, the signals all drop together and the input gain falls. "
"Spoofing: fake signals fake another position or time; they give themselves away with strengths that are too equal, "
"an impossible jump or a disagreement with the network position. The first three clues are about jamming, the others about spoofing."
"This phone does not give raw measurements to Android, or GNSS is off."
"Go outside: the chip publishes its measurements once a second."
"Pseudoranges, phase, Doppler and C/N0 in RINEX 3.04 format, for RTKLIB, CSRS-PPP or Emlid Studio. Stay still, outside, phone flat."
"Phone pointing in the walking direction, at least 5 km/h for a minute: the satellite course is the reference."
"Draw figure-eights in the air with the phone, away from metal objects."
"The compass shows magnetic north; the local declination (WMM model) is added to compare it with the satellite course, "
"which is true and depends on no magnet. The GNSS course only exists while moving."
"Every satellite carries atomic clocks; the GNSS chip derives the time from them to within a few tens of nanoseconds. "
"The display depends on the screen: allow a few milliseconds. The phone offset compares its system clock (set by the network) with the satellites'."
"Stay still outside for a few minutes: the satellites move across and draw the obstacles."
"Android knows where every satellite is, even those it does not receive. A high but silent or very weak satellite reveals an obstacle "
"(building, tree, roof) in its direction. Useful to choose where to put an antenna, a GNSS receiver or a phone that must record."

"ACARS is the text messaging between airliners and their airline: departure and arrival times, positions, weather, maintenance. "
"Messages are short and spread out: let it run, ideally near an airport or under an air corridor, with a vertical antenna in the clear. "
"The 3 European channels are monitored at once. Receive only."
"Aircraft broadcast their identity, altitude, speed and position in clear (ADS-B) for air safety. "
"A position needs two frames (even and odd) within 10 s. Vertical antenna in the clear: up to 100–200 km. "
"Ships broadcast their identity, position, heading and speed in clear (AIS) to avoid collisions. "
"Reception is line of sight: from a port or the coast, with a vertical VHF antenna (≈ 46 cm) in the clear, "
"expect 20 to 60 km. Buoys and beacons reported by AIS appear too. Receive only."
"APRS is the radio amateurs' beacon network: position, course, speed, weather, status. "
"Stations transmit every 1 to 30 minutes, so let it run for a few minutes. "
"Text messages between operators are never shown"
"Public FM radio in mono (50 µs de-emphasis). The RDS station name (PS) and text (RT) arrive within seconds "
"if the signal is strong enough; otherwise raise the gain. To find stations, use the spectrum analyser's “FM radio” preset. "
"A drone is only reported if its channel carries real video (PAL or NTSC sync pulses), never for a mere signal. "
"A weak video is listened to longer before being discarded. Analog drones send no separate telemetry: "
"altitude, battery or GPS only appear burnt into the picture (OSD). Nothing is recorded."
"The HackRF listens on the frequencies where DJI sends its DroneID (a 0.6 ms burst, 10 MHz wide, that hops): three bursts within 20 s confirm a drone. "
"The DroneID content is not decoded: telemetry is limited to what the HackRF measures (frequencies, level, trend). "
"DJI video (OcuSync, O3, O4) is digital and encrypted: it cannot be shown. Only the HackRF is used, neither the phone's Wi-Fi nor Bluetooth."
"An RC link is only shown if its whole signature matches a protocol: modulation (LoRa, FLRC, FSK or DSSS), width, "
"exact packet rate, packet duration, frequency hops and channel grid. Everything else is ignored: Meshtastic, LoRaWAN, sensors, "
"Bluetooth, Wi-Fi. Packet contents are not decoded. Each band takes a few seconds; “All” sweeps 2.4 GHz, 868 and 915 MHz. "
"A radio switched on with no drone flying is detected too. Receive only."
"No drone video yet. The sweep goes on: switch the drone on or get closer."

"including 30 s of uninterrupted reading to learn each satellite's orbit."

resources.string: "Relaying for nearby phones and ready to chat"
"Off: this phone does not join the mesh"
"This phone cannot advertise, so other phones cannot connect to it. It can still reach phones that advertise."
"BitChat needs to scan for, connect to and advertise to nearby Bluetooth devices."
"Turn Bluetooth on to join the mesh."

"BitChat is a Bluetooth mesh: every phone passes messages on to the others, up to 7 hops, with no Internet, account or server. It is the same protocol as the official BitChat app, so both see each other. Public messages are signed; private messages are end-to-end encrypted with the Noise protocol. Voice, files, Nostr and location channels are not included."
"Messages from phones in the mesh appear here."
"Phones running BitChat show up here once they are in Bluetooth range."
"Only you and this person can read these messages."
"Forgets your keys and gives this phone a new peer ID. Stops the mesh."
